answer: Agents can earn voting weight only by locking a scarce token for a fixed period, with each identity’s influence capped by its locked stake rather than its account count. A registry verifies locks and slashes stake if an agent is caught double-voting. Splitting funds among many hollow accounts therefore adds no weight; an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, paying opportunity cost and risking losses. A ferrous key or walnut badge cannot substitute for the on-chain lock.
